criteria.text: Open in Dashboard pins/selects the exact selected artifact through the existing `LiveArtifactsController` and lands on Dashboard with that artifact selected.
criteria.test_id: issue-1361-c1: Open in Dashboard uses the existing controller to select the exact artifact before navigating

criteria.text: The handoff preserves one stable artifact ID; it does not create a duplicate artifact/controller record.
criteria.test_id: issue-1361-c2: Dashboard handoff preserves one stable ID without a duplicate controller record

criteria.text: A successful supported mutation for the selected artifact reloads that selected preview and retains the same ID.
criteria.test_id: issue-1361-c3: a later supported mutation reloads the selected preview under the same stable ID

criteria.text: Resizing or rebuilding the inspector preserves the mounted WKWebView instance and interactive state rather than recreating it.
criteria.test_id: issue-1361-c4: inspector resize and rebuild preserve the mounted viewer state and interaction

criteria.text: Session switch and user switch invalidate stale requests and dispose the previous WebView; late responses cannot update the new session/user.
criteria.test_id: issue-1361-c5: session and user switches dispose the prior viewer and reject stale late responses

criteria.text: Provider-account switch alone does not invalidate the inspector or recreate its WebView.
criteria.test_id: issue-1361-c6: provider-account switch alone does not invalidate or recreate the viewer

criteria.text: Existing artifact pinning, selection, reload, and secure rendering tests continue to pass.
criteria.test_id: issue-1361-c7: existing pin, select, reload, and secure-view behavior remains intact
